title: Alleged Firing Of Shots At Netherlands Marines During Drill On The Race Course

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

CRIME DIARY.

"A" Division.
CRIME REGISTER No:— Misc. 213/37. Chengtu Road Police Station.
October 29, 1937.

Diary Number:— Nature of Offence:—

Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day | Places visited in course of investigation each day
---|---

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Alleged firing of shots at Netherland's Marines during Drill on the Racecourse.

Further investigations have been conducted regarding the complaint made vide this report, but nothing has been gained that would substantiate the impression of deliberate shooting, as suspected by the authorities concerned.

D.I. Boddy, Senior Detective i/c Sinza Station was communicated with and caused enquiries to be made opposite the scene, but no information was obtained and the above detective officer is of the same opinion that was expressed by the undersigned on Diary No. 1.

The undersigned and D.S.I. Tsai Liu made enquiries at the New World Hotel, where it was discovered that the roof is at present under repair and not available to residents.

No person was located at the above hotel, who had heard shots fired on the days stated other than the reports emanating from the war area. Although there is no doubt that shots were fired, from investigations made, it would appear that a mistake has occurred, regarding any deliberate attack on THE military force concerned.

调查记录。

指控在跑马厅操练期间向荷兰海军陆战队开枪。

已就本报告所述投诉进行了进一步调查，但未获得任何能证实有关当局所怀疑的故意射击印象的证据。

已与静安寺捕房高级探员兼主管 Boddy 警探联系，并安排在对面的现场进行查询，但未获得任何信息，上述探员所持意见与本人在日志第1号中表达的意见相同。

本人与副督察蔡刘（Tsai Liu，音译）在新世界大酒店进行了查询，发现该酒店屋顶目前正在维修，不向住客开放。

除来自战区的报告外，在上述酒店未找到任何声称在所述日期听到枪声的人。虽然毫无疑问确实发生了枪击，但根据调查结果，似乎是在针对有关军事力量的故意袭击这一问题上出现了误判。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

**Alleged firing of shots at Netherland's Marines during drill on the Racecourse.**

At about 4 p.m. on the 28-10-37, information was received from D.C.I. Ross attached to the Special Branch that a complaint had been made by the Authorities of the Netherlands Destroyer, Van Galen, that during drill practice on the Racecourse on the 27-10-37 and 28-10-37 rifle shots had been fired at the Marines on parade.

The undersigned communicated with the above destroyer and arranged an interview with Lieutenant Leistenick, Officer in charge of the parades, and at 4.45 p.m. the following information was obtained.

At 8 a.m. on the 27-10-37, the Netherlands Marines were drilling on Recreation Ground No. 1 facing Bubbling Well Road, and during the parades, the report of two shots were stated to have been heard, this being followed by the whine of bullets, passing low overhead.

No report was made to Lieutenant Leistenick, who was in charge of the parade and, who had failed to hear the shots.

At 10.35 a.m. on the 28-10-37, on the same ground, three more reports were heard, and then the whine of bullets passing low overhead, this time being heard by Lieutenant Leistenick, who was then informed of the shots the previous day.

**指控在跑马厅操练期间向荷兰海军陆战队开枪。**

1937年10月28日下午4时许，接到附属于特别分支的副总督察 Ross 的情报，称荷兰驱逐舰“范·加伦”号（Van Galen）当局提出投诉，称在1937年10月27日和28日于跑马厅进行操练演习期间，有人向列队的海军陆战队队员发射步枪子弹。

本人与上述驱逐舰取得联系，并安排了与负责操练的 Leistenick 中尉会面，于下午4时45分获得了以下信息。

1937年10月27日上午8时，荷兰海军陆战队正在面向静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的第一娱乐场（Recreation Ground No. 1）进行操练，据称在列队期间听到了两声枪响，随后听到子弹从低空掠过头顶的呼啸声。

当时负责操练且未听到枪声的 Leistenick 中尉未收到任何报告。

1937年10月28日上午10时35分，在同一场地又听到了三声枪响，随后再次听到子弹从低空掠过头顶的呼啸声，这次 Leistenick 中尉听到了，并随即被告知了前一天的枪击情况。

CRIME REGISTER No:— ____________________ Division.
____________________ Police Station.

Diary Number:— 1/2. Nature of Offence:—

| Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day | Places visited in course of investigation each day |
| :--- | :--- |
| | |

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Informant stated that no aircraft were operating in the vicinity on either day, and the shots appeared to be fired from the North.

The authorities are of the impression that the shots were deliberately fired at the Netherlands Marines, this being supposed due to the absence of aircraft, direction of flight and the low trajectory.

It was pointed out that in all probability, the bullets were the result of stray shooting, but this explanation is not acceptable. Lieutenant Leistenick stating that it was probably some person shooting from buildings facing the Racecourse, in between the China United Apartments and the New World.

Due to the above, drills have been discontinued, pending enquiries by Police and subsequent report.

In the opinion of the undersigned, the bullets on the 27-10-37 were stray shots fired during the early morning evacuation of Chapel by the Chinese troops, and those on the 28-10-37, resulted from firing between troops still operating in the vicinity of North Yu Ya Ching Road, and the Chapel Boundary.

Search for the spent bullets failed to locate them.

调查记录。

线人称，在这两天内附近均无飞机活动，枪声似乎来自北方。

当局认为这些子弹是故意射向荷兰海军陆战队的，这一推测是基于没有飞机、飞行方向以及弹道低平等因素。

有人指出，这些子弹极有可能是流弹所致，但这一解释不被接受。Leistenick 中尉称，可能是有人从跑马厅对面、位于华懋公寓（China United Apartments）和新世界之间的建筑物内射击。

鉴于上述情况，操练已暂停，等待警方调查及后续报告。

本人认为，1937年10月27日的子弹是中国军队在清晨撤离教堂（Chapel）期间发射的流弹，而1937年10月28日的子弹则是仍在北虞洽卿路（North Yu Ya Ching Road）附近及教堂边界一带活动的部队之间交火所致。

搜寻弹头未果。

“A”区副总监。
D.C.
~~o- 1/8~~ (S.B.)
